about_the_game:
Who knew cleaning could be fun? In Spong' It!, you take control of a high-speed, sponge-equipped RC car, turning cleaning into a thrilling, score-chasing challenge. Chain drifts, near misses, and jumps to rack up massive combos and keep the bubbles flowing! With each in-game day, complete contracts, upgrade your ride, and push your skills to the limit. Can you master the art of stylish cleaning?

Shine Up the Kitchen!

Blast through dust and grime as you slide, spin, and zip across the floor. Get to work! Shine those floors.

Clean With Style!

Speed alone isn’t enough—precision and skill are key! Pull off drifts, airtime tricks, and near misses to rack up massive combos. The smoother your moves, the bigger your rewards!

Supercharge Your Ride!

Need more speed? A bigger sponge? Extra time? Spend your hard-earned bubbles in the shop to upgrade your RC cleaning machine and take your cleaning to the next level!

Take On Daily Cleaning Contracts!

Each day presents a new challenge—drift for 30 seconds, land 50 near misses, or fully clean a zone! Earn stars based on your performance, build up streaks, and chase high scores!

Level Up Your Skills with Badges!

The better you clean, the more you earn! Master each challenge to upgrade your badges, increasing your rewards and unlocking new ways to boost your score!

Customize Your Ride!

Drift in style with unlockable customizations! Swap out your car’s paint, pick a fresh sponge, or change your bubbly trails.

Game Features:

  • Shine Up the Kitchen: Slide, spin, and zip through dust and grime to clean floors.

  • Clean With Style: Speed, precision, and skill are key to achieving massive combos.

  • Supercharge Your Ride: Use earned bubbles to upgrade speed, sponge size, and time.

  • Take On Daily Cleaning Contracts: New challenges daily, earn stars and build streaks.

  • Level Up Your Skills with Badges: Master challenges to earn badges and boost your rewards.

  • Customize Your Ride: Unlock and apply customizations to your car, sponge, and trails.
